description: High-fidelity numerical solution of the 1D viscous Burgers equation, forward transient (SciC).
user_request:
Let's solve the 1D Viscous Burgers' equation; with nu=1/(100pi)
Domain: $(x,) \in [-1,1]$, $t \in [0, 1]$.
BCs: Periodic x

Initial Condition:
$$ u(x,0) = -sin(pi x) $$

The final plot must be saved as summary_all.png it should include snapshots of several timesteps
